About this item

  • YOUR DREAM TUMBLER: Whichever way your day flows, the H2.0 FlowState tumbler keeps you refreshed with fewer refills. Double wall vacuum insulation means drinks stay cold, iced or hot for hours. Choose between our 14oz, 20oz, 30oz,40oz and 64oz options depending on your hydration needs. The narrow base on all sizes (except 64oz) fits just about any car cup holder, keeping it right by your side.
  • ADVANCED LID CONSTRUCTION: Whether you prefer small sips or maximum thirst quenching, Stanley has developed an advanced FlowState lid, featuring a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top for added leak resistance. We’ve also included an ergonomic, comfort-grip handle, so you can easily carry your ice-cold water to work, meetings, the gym or trips out of town.
  • EARTH-FRIENDLY DURABILITY: Constructed of 90% recycled BPA free stainless steel for sustainable sipping, the Stanley Quencher H2.0 has the durability to stand up to a lifetime of use. Eliminate the use of single-use plastic bottles and straws with a travel tumbler built with sustainability in mind.
  • DISHWASHER SAFE: Spend less time hunched over the sink and more time doing the things you love. Cleaning your tumbler and lid couldn't be easier, just pop them into the dishwasher. Unlike plastic bottles that retain stains & smells, this metallic beauty comes out pristine
  • LIFETIME WARRANTY: Since 1913 we’ve promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink - accessories built to last a lifetime. It’s a promise we still keep. Stanley products purchased from Stanley Resellers come with a lifetime warranty. Rest easy knowing we’ve got your back through it all.

Product Description

This Quencher H2.0 is generously sized (but not oversized) with an easy-carry, comfort-grip handle and a narrow base that will fit most cup holders. Long day of meetings? Rowing class? Trip out of town? Our durable 30 oz tumbler, made with recycled stainless steel, is up to the hydration challenge. The double-wall vacuum insulation will keep your water cold for 9 hours and iced for 40 hours. And to cap things off, there’s an advanced FlowState™ lid that features a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top.

5 out of 5 stars
Quencher H2.0 Flow State Tumbler, 40 oz, Black Chroma
I have two Stanleys, my first one was a creamy white, and this one is black. Even though I had had the first one for several months, I purchased this black chroma one right before Christmas two years ago. My mother knew that I had wanted a Stanley for Christmas and also purchased me this same tumbler (I had asked her to get it, but forgot that I had asked her). I had to return the one I purchased and kept the Christmas present from my mother. Both tumblers, the black one and the white one have held up extremely well over a two year span. The drinks are kept cold for an exceptionally long time. My only complaint about Stanley tumblers have been that the straw leaks if you tip it in both the black and white versions that I have. I do see that Stanley does have non-leaky versions of lid that come with other items of theirs. I have also used competitor brand lids if I want to go anywhere other than the usual places. It's a beautiful thing that competitor lids do fit my Stanley tumblers. I really enjoy the fact that with the black tumbler it's hard to tell if it's dirty. I am always using one of my Stanleys on a daily basis, so I'm sure I would purchase this item again if needed and I would recommend this item to my family.

    With Stanley, I mean... how can you really go wrong?

    Variety & Selection

    The color selections is always on point, always fun, always a variety and I LOOOOOVE the limited edition and seasonal colors and patterns!

    I have both the 30 oz and also 40 oz Quencher tumblers, LOVE both. I keep the 40oz at home and 30oz in the car.

    Functionality

    The 30 and 40oz Quenchers are the most functional for me. 40oz are the ones that stay in the house and at the office, because they can be heavy when full and I like to keep lots of water readily accessible in the places I inhabit for long periods of time.

    The 30oz stays in the car, and its SO handy b/c when I fill it up and put some ice it actually keeps the water cold even in the middle of our HOT HOT summer! I was stunned when I realized this for the first time. I also don't have to worry too much about keeping it the hot car b/c it's not plastic.

    Durability

    Very durable! I've had several of mine for years now and still looks pristine! No scuffs, chips or dents thus far and I've dropped them at least once.

    Price & Value

    Full price is a little rich for my blood, but that would be for any style or brand of tumbler. So, I always catch these when they're on sale, which you can find from time to time if you keep your eyes out!!!

    Overall

    LOVE and don't own any other brands b/c I love and use these ones so much I don't really need any other types or brands.

    I have two Stanleys, my first one was a creamy white, and this one is black. Even though I had had the first one for several months, I purchased this black chroma one right before Christmas two years ago. My mother knew that I had wanted a Stanley for Christmas and also purchased me this same tumbler (I had asked her to get it, but forgot that I had asked her).   • Srish
    4 out of 5 stars
    Lives up to the hype — with one real caveat about the straw
    Reviewed in the United States on June 5, 2026
    Size: 30 OuncesColor: Rose Quartz 2.0
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I'll be honest: I was skeptical about paying this much for a water bottle. A few months in, it's earned it.

    Insulation is genuinely impressive. I fill it with ice water in the morning and there's still ice in there at the end of a full workday. No other tumbler I've owned has done that consistently. The outside stays completely dry too — no condensation rings on your desk or car seat.

    The Flowstate lid is the feature I didn't know I needed. Three positions (straw, sip, closed) and it rotates smoothly. I use the straw position all day and the closed setting when I toss it in my bag.

    Cup holder fit: yes, it actually fits. The H2.0 redesigned the base specifically for this and it works — fits my car's cup holder without forcing it.

    The one real issue: if the tumbler tips over with the straw in, liquid leaks out through the straw opening. It's not fully spill-proof. I've had it knock over on my desk and it made a mess. Worth knowing before you put it near a laptop or in a bag without the straw removed. It's a lid designed for drinking, not for carrying around at an angle.

    The Rose Quartz color is accurate to photos — a soft, muted dusty pink. Not hot pink, not beige. Genuinely pretty.

    Worth the money if you actually use a tumbler daily. If you're on the fence about the price, you'll stop questioning it within a week.

About this Item

  • YOUR DREAM TUMBLER: Whichever way your day flows, the H2.0 FlowState tumbler keeps you refreshed with fewer refills. Double wall vacuum insulation means drinks stay cold, iced or hot for hours. Choose between our 14oz, 20oz, 30oz,40oz and 64oz options depending on your hydration needs. The narrow base on all sizes (except 64oz) fits just about any car cup holder, keeping it right by your side.
  • ADVANCED LID CONSTRUCTION: Whether you prefer small sips or maximum thirst quenching, Stanley has developed an advanced FlowState lid, featuring a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top for added leak resistance. We’ve also included an ergonomic, comfort-grip handle, so you can easily carry your ice-cold water to work, meetings, the gym or trips out of town.
  • EARTH-FRIENDLY DURABILITY: Constructed of 90% recycled BPA free stainless steel for sustainable sipping, the Stanley Quencher H2.0 has the durability to stand up to a lifetime of use. Eliminate the use of single-use plastic bottles and straws with a travel tumbler built with sustainability in mind.
  • DISHWASHER SAFE: Spend less time hunched over the sink and more time doing the things you love. Cleaning your tumbler and lid couldn't be easier, just pop them into the dishwasher. Unlike plastic bottles that retain stains & smells, this metallic beauty comes out pristine
  • LIFETIME WARRANTY: Since 1913 we’ve promised to provide rugged, capable gear for food and drink - accessories built to last a lifetime. It’s a promise we still keep. Stanley products purchased from Stanley Resellers come with a lifetime warranty. Rest easy knowing we’ve got your back through it all.

Product Description

This Quencher H2.0 is generously sized (but not oversized) with an easy-carry, comfort-grip handle and a narrow base that will fit most cup holders. Long day of meetings? Rowing class? Trip out of town? Our durable 30 oz tumbler, made with recycled stainless steel, is up to the hydration challenge. The double-wall vacuum insulation will keep your water cold for 9 hours and iced for 40 hours. And to cap things off, there’s an advanced FlowState™ lid that features a rotating cover with three positions: a straw opening designed to resist splashes with a seal that holds the reusable straw in place, a drink opening, and a full-cover top.
